gen-gf-the-girl-next-door-fs-hind: Handwritten and personable, with a broad hooked c up top. Hind keeps its lowercase close to capital height and its strokes taut as string, though pages of paragraphs would wear thin.
gen-gf-the-girl-next-door-fs-pilcrow-rou: Pilcrow Rounded packs its letters tight, with big counters and curves that refuse to close. Pilcrow Rounded sits beneath The Girl Next Door warmly enough, yet long paragraphs are not what this pair is for.
gen-gf-the-girl-next-door-fs-technor: Technor reads like a glowing neon tube, cool and geometric, with little height difference between its cases. And The Girl Next Door adds warmth, though both do better on a line or two than on pages.
gen-gf-tillana-fs-karma: Karma reads like a trusted old book, its terminals finishing clear of the stem and its modulation gentle. But shrink Tillana down and its chunky, tall midzone stops commanding the page.
gen-gf-tillana-fs-paquito: Chunky, tall midzones give Tillana its commanding look, with open-ended curves throughout. And Paquito, a confident serif with hardly any gap from lowercase to capitals, tires if asked to carry a lot of text.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Commanding, tube-like strokes of constant width make Tilt Neon hard to miss, with a splayed c. And BhuTuka Expanded One, curvy and unclamped, slows everything beneath it to a leisurely walk.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-hepta-slab: Bold, tube-like letters set the tone in Tilt Neon. Hepta Slab does the quieter work, its open counters breathing into the white space and its stretched-out words inviting a slower, bookish read.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-kiwi-maru: Tilt Neon draws tube-like strokes of constant width, with a splayed c and short ascenders. And it earns its keep big and short, while Kiwi Maru handles traditional, editorial text with generous letterspace.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: A splayed c terminal and tube-like strokes of constant width give Tilt Neon its loud, commanding presence up front. Padyakke Expanded One does the slower work, spreading wide-mouthed letters out.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Authoritative from the first glance, Tilt Neon shouts with tube-like strokes and short ascenders. And Stint Ultra Expanded does the patient work, each character floating apart with open counters.
